steps.code: SetCVar('autoLootDefault','0'); QATargetDeaths=0; QATargetClears=0; QALootClosed=0; QATargetWatch=CreateFrame('Frame'); QATargetWatch:RegisterEvent('COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED'); QATargetWatch:RegisterEvent('PLAYER_TARGET_CHANGED'); QATargetWatch:RegisterEvent('LOOT_CLOSED'); QATargetWatch:SetScript('OnEvent',function(self,event,...) if event=='COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED' then local r={...}; if r[2]=='UNIT_DIED' and r[6]==QACorpse then QATargetDeaths=QATargetDeaths+1 end elseif event=='PLAYER_TARGET_CHANGED' and not UnitExists('target') then QATargetClears=QATargetClears+1 elseif event=='LOOT_CLOSED' then QALootClosed=QALootClosed+1 end end)

steps.condition: QATargetDeaths>0 and QATargetClears==1 and not UnitExists('target') and not TargetFrame:IsVisible()

steps.code: QALootMoney=GetMoney(); QALootExpected={}; for i=1,GetNumLootItems() do local link=GetLootSlotLink(i); if link then local id=tonumber(link:match('item:(%d+)')); local _,_,count=GetLootSlotInfo(i); QALootExpected[id]=GetItemCount(id)+count end end; CloseLoot()
assert(UnitGUID('target')==QACorpse and QATargetClears==1,'cancelling uncollected loot keeps the corpse selected')

steps.condition: QALootClosed==2 and QATargetClears==2 and not LootFrame:IsShown() and not UnitExists('target') and not TargetFrame:IsVisible()

steps.code: for id,count in pairs(QALootExpected) do assert(GetItemCount(id)>=count,'server acknowledged collected item') end; assert(GetMoney()>=QALootMoney); QATargetWatch:UnregisterAllEvents()
